verdict.rationale: Pipecat is fundamentally code-first: the CLI covers init/scaffolding, cloud deploy, evals, and context-hub (pipecat-probe-rt-1, pipecat-docs-16/34/37), and the framework itself is the primary interface. But evidence never explicitly confirms that Pipecat Cloud's web dashboard (agent profiles, concurrency settings, monitoring) exposes no exclusive UI-only functionality, nor does it document a full REST/OpenAPI surface (probe shows no discoverable OpenAPI spec, pipecat-probe-2) for programmatic parity with any cloud console. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, documented OpenAPI/REST API for Pipecat Cloud console features, and confirmation no dashboard-only settings exist.
